Instructions for Submitting a Medi-Cal Claim Form for Beneficiary Reimbursement 
(Medical or Dental Payment Refund) 
Who May File a Claim?   
Anyone who has paid for medical or dental services that they think are normally covered by Medi-Cal may 
file a claim for a refund. Anyone filing on behalf of the beneficiary must include their relationship to the 
beneficiary when signing the form or any related documents. To get a refund, you must have received and 
paid for the service: 
A. During the retroactive eligibility period of up to three months prior to the date of your filed application
that must have already been granted by your county and documented on your file; or
B. While you waited for your Medi-Cal application to be decided. If you received services on or after
February 2, 2006, to get a refund for payments, you must have paid a provider who accepts
Medi-Cal; or
C. After you received your Medi-Cal card. To get a refund for payments made after you received your
Medi-Cal card, you must have paid a provider who accepts Medi-Cal.
How Do I File a Claim? 
To file a claim, you must submit a Medi-Cal Claim Form for Beneficiary Reimbursement. 
•
The claim form must be filled out in blue or black ink;
•
The claim form must have an original signature (no copies will be accepted);
The Claim Form must include: 
•
A photo copy of your Medi-Cal Beneficiary Identification Card (BIC).
•
Proof of payment. Examples include a copy of a cancelled check(s) from the bank (front & back),
receipt(s) from the provider you paid, evidence of electronic payment, or a copy of a money order. A
declaration may be used in some situations to explain, supplement or support the documents above.
•
A completed PAYEE DATA RECORD Form.
•
For those services that would have required Medi-Cal authorization, documentation from the medical
or dental provider that shows medical necessity for the service.
•
An itemized billing statement indicating the date(s) of service; and the service(s) and/or service
code(s) for which you paid out-of-pocket to the provider(s).
Note: Please complete an individual Provider Information page for each of the providers and be sure to list 
the amount (you wish to be reimbursed) that you paid to each of the providers. 
What is Timely Filing? 
1. Claims for services provided on June 27, 1997 through November 16, 2006: For services provided 
between June 27, 1997 and November 16, 2006, your claim must be received by November 16, 2007 
or within 90 days of receipt of your Medi-Cal card, whichever is later.
2. Claims for service(s) provided on or after November 16, 2006: For service(s) provided on or after 
November 16, 2007, your claim must be received within one year of the date that you received the 
service(s) or within 90 days of receipt of your Medi-Cal card, whichever is later.
Where Do I Send Claims? 
1. Claims for refunds for payments made for Medical, Mental Health, Alcohol and Drug Program
treatments, and In Home Supportive Services Should be mailed to:
Beneficiary Service Center, P.O. Box 138008, Sacramento, CA 95813-8008
2. Claims for refunds for payments made for dental services should be mailed to:
Beneficiary Service Center, P.O. Box 526026, Sacramento, CA 95852-6026
提交 Medi‑Cal 受益人报销申请表的说明
（医疗或牙科费用退款）
谁可以提出索赔？
任何已支付医疗或牙科服务费用，且认为这些服务通常由加州医疗补助计划 (Medi‑Cal) 承保的人，都可以
提出退款索赔。任何代表受益人提出索赔的人，在签署表格或任何相关文件时，必须说明其与受益人的关系。
要获得退款，您必须已接受并支付了该服务费用：
A. 在您提交申请之日前最多三个月的追溯资格期内
该资格必须已由您所在的县授予并记录在您的档案中；或
B. 在您等待 Medi‑Cal 申请结果期间。如果您在 2006 年 2 月 2
日或之后接受了服务，要获得退款，您必须向接受 Medi‑Cal 的服务提供商付款；
C. 在您收到 Medi‑Cal 卡之后。要获得收到 Medi‑Cal 卡后所支付款项的退款，
您必须向接受 Medi‑Cal 的医疗服务提供商付款。
我该如何提交索赔申请？
要提交索赔申请，您必须提交一份“Medi‑Cal受益人报销索赔表”。
• 索赔申请表必须用蓝色或黑色墨水填写；
• 索赔申请表必须有原件签名（不接受复印件）；
索赔申请表必须包含：
•
您的 Medi‑Cal 受益人识别卡 (BIC) 复印件。
•
付款证明。例如，银行出具的已作废支票复印件（正反面）、
您支付的医疗服务提供者的收据、电子支付凭证或汇票复印件。
在某些情况下，可以使用声明来解释、补充或支持上述文件。
•
已填写的收款人数据记录表。
•
对于需要 Medi‑Cal 授权的服务，需提供医疗
或牙科服务提供者出具的证明该服务具有医疗必要性的文件。
•
详细的账单，注明服务日期；以及您自费支付给医疗服务提供者的服务项目和/或服务
代码。
注意：请为每位服务提供商填写一份单独的“服务提供商信息”页面，并务必列出您支付给每位服务提供商的金额（您希望获得报销）。
什么是及时申报？
1. 1997年6月27日至2006年11月16日期间接受的服务：
对于1997年6月27日至2006年11月16日期间接受的服务，您的索赔申请必须在2007年11月16日之前收到，
或者在收到您的Medi‑Cal卡后90天内收到，以较晚者为准。
2. 2006年11月16日或之后接受的服务：
对于2007年11月16日或之后接受的服务，您的索赔申请必须在您接受服务之日起一年内收到，
或者在收到您的Medi‑Cal卡后90天内收到，以较晚者为准。
我应该把索赔申请寄到哪里？
1. 申请退还已支付的医疗、心理健康、酒精和药物治疗项目以及居家支持服务费用的申请，请邮寄至：
受益人服务中心，邮政信箱 138008，萨克拉门托，加利福尼亚州 95813‑8008
2. 申请退还已支付的牙科服务费用的申请，请邮寄至：
受益人服务中心，邮政信箱 526026，萨克拉门托，加利福尼亚州 95852‑6026
